mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT sp.permission_code FROM sys_user_role sur INNER JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.id = sur.role_id AND sr.is_deleted = 0 AND sr.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission srp ON srp.role_id = sr.id AND srp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_permission sp ON sp.id = srp.permission_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.status = 1 WHERE sur.user_id = #{userId} AND sur.is_deleted = 0
